proposals.name: Amateur Radio (Ham Radio) Operators
proposals.buyer_persona: Dedicated hobbyists, often engineers or tech-savvy individuals, deeply invested in the technical and communicative aspects of radio. They appreciate precise, functional designs, historical references, and inside jokes related to call signs, Q codes, and equipment. Age range tends to be 40+, but a younger demographic is emerging.
product_angles: Vintage radio schematic designs for t-shirts/posters
Q-code cheat sheet mugs/mousepads
Custom call sign merchandise (mug, hat, patch)
Logbook templates (KDP)
Antenna design diagrams (vector art for merch/3D print STL)
3D printable accessories for specific radio models (e.g., stand, knob, case)
proposals.first_test_product: T-shirt with a detailed vintage radio schematic and a common Q-code phrase (e.g., 'CQ DX')

proposals.name: Urban Sketchers / Plein Air Artists
proposals.buyer_persona: Artists who enjoy drawing on location, often in urban environments. They value portability, durability, and unique ways to document their experiences. They are creative, community-oriented, and appreciate items that reflect their passion for capturing moments and scenes. Often active on Instagram and local meetups.
product_angles: Sketchbook covers with architectural elements or cityscapes (KDP)
Printable travel journal inserts for sketching trips
Merch designs with minimalist drawing tools (pens, brushes, sketchbooks)
3D printable palette/water pot holders for on-the-go sketching
Digital brush packs for Procreate/Clip Studio Paint (adjacent to gamedev assets)
Notion templates for organizing sketch challenges and art progress
proposals.first_test_product: KDP paperback sketchbook with a unique cover featuring a stylized urban scene and encouraging prompts on interior pages.

proposals.name: Indie TTRPG (Tabletop Role-Playing Game) Creators/Players
proposals.buyer_persona: Creative individuals who design, play, and consume independently published TTRPGs. They seek unique mechanics, diverse settings, and tools to enhance their storytelling. They appreciate art, clear rules, and resources that streamline game preparation and play. Often active on itch.io, Kickstarter, and specialized forums.
product_angles: Printable character sheets for niche TTRPG systems (KDP/Etsy)
Digital maps and asset packs (top-down views, tokens, props)
AI prompt packs for generating TTRPG plot hooks, NPCs, or magic items
Merch designs with minimalist dice, fantasy creatures, or specific TTRPG tropes
3D printable terrain pieces or mini bases
Notion templates for campaign planning and session prep
proposals.best_pipeline_or_new: produce_gamedev_asset_pack, produce_kdp_cover, produce_merch_designs, produce_stl_parametric, new_ai_prompt_packs, new_notion_templates
proposals.first_test_product: Printable PDF pack of 5 unique character sheets for a generic fantasy TTRPG, including themed art and functional layout.

proposals.name: Museum Gift Shops (Local & Niche Museums)
proposals.buyer_persona: Museum gift shop managers or directors looking for unique, locally relevant merchandise that tells a story and generates revenue. They need items that reflect their specific collection, history, or geographic location, often with a focus on educational value or artistic merit. Budget-conscious, but value quality and authenticity.
product_angles: Custom coloring books based on museum collections (e.g., local history, specific artifacts)
SVG packs of historical artifacts or local landmarks for their own merch/signage
Postcards/prints featuring public domain art from their collection (if applicable)
3D printable replicas of small, non-copyrighted artifacts for educational kits or display
Low-content journals with themed historical facts or designs
Merch designs (t-shirts, mugs) featuring unique museum logos, dates, or historical figures
proposals.best_pipeline_or_new: produce_coloring_book, produce_svg_pack, produce_vintage_pd_from_cdc, produce_stl_parametric, produce_merch_designs, new_b2b_custom_assets
proposals.first_test_product: A sample coloring book PDF (e.g., 5 pages) based on a local historical society's public domain archives, to pitch as a custom product.

proposals.name: Specialty Coffee Roasters & Baristas (B2B/Sub-Culture)
proposals.buyer_persona: Individuals and small businesses deeply immersed in the craft of specialty coffee. They value quality, origin, brewing techniques, and the aesthetic of coffee culture. Baristas, roasters, coffee shop owners, and serious home brewers. They appreciate insider terminology, minimalist design, and tools that enhance their craft. They are distinct from 'generic coffee lovers'.
product_angles: Merch designs with minimalist coffee bean/equipment illustrations, brewing diagrams, or coffee chemistry formulas
KDP journals for logging coffee tastings and brew recipes
SVG packs of coffee plant illustrations, latte art patterns, or roasting profiles for local roasters to use
Notion templates for coffee shop inventory, shift schedules, or roast profiling
3D printable tamper holders, portafilter stands, or dosing funnels for specific espresso machines
Coloring books depicting the coffee journey from bean to cup, focusing on origins and methods.
proposals.best_pipeline_or_new: produce_merch_designs, produce_kdp_cover, produce_svg_pack, produce_stl_parametric, produce_coloring_book, new_notion_templates
proposals.first_test_product: SVG pack of 10 stylized, minimalist coffee bean and brewing equipment icons for use by small roasters/cafes on their own branding or merch.

proposals.name: Niche Godot Engine Developers (e.g., Pixel Art, Mobile, Educational)
proposals.buyer_persona: Indie game developers using the Godot Engine, often focused on specific art styles (pixel art), platforms (mobile), or game genres (educational, puzzle). They seek high-quality, ready-to-use assets that save time and fit their project's aesthetic. They appreciate open-source values and community support. Often on itch.io, Godot Asset Library, and Reddit.
product_angles: Pixel art asset packs (characters, tilesets, props) specifically designed for Godot's tilemap system
Godot project templates for common mobile game mechanics (e.g., endless runner, puzzle platformer)
Sound effect packs (8-bit, chiptune) for indie Godot games
UI/UX asset packs optimized for mobile Godot interfaces
Merch designs for Godot engine enthusiasts (e.g., stylized engine logo, GDScript jokes)
Notion templates for Godot game development project management
proposals.first_test_product: A small pixel art asset pack (e.g., 1 character, 1 tileset, 3 props) fully integrated and demonstrated in a simple Godot demo project.

proposals.name: Historical Reenactors (Specific Eras: Roman, Medieval, WWII)
proposals.buyer_persona: Individuals deeply committed to historical accuracy in their portrayal of past eras. They spend significant time and money on authentic costumes, props, and research. They value detailed information, accurate designs, and functional items that enhance their reenactment experience. Strong community bonds and often involved in living history events.
product_angles: KDP journals/notebooks with historically accurate covers (e.g., Roman legionary shield, medieval illuminated manuscript style)
Merch designs featuring historical symbols, unit insignias, or quotes from the era (non-copyrighted)
3D printable replicas of small, non-weapon historical artifacts (e.g., Roman dice, medieval belt buckles, WWII era buttons)
Coloring books depicting daily life or famous battles of a specific era
Printable historical maps or period documents (public domain)
SVG packs of historical patterns or motifs for costume makers
proposals.best_pipeline_or_new: produce_kdp_cover, produce_merch_designs, produce_stl_parametric, produce_coloring_book, produce_svg_pack, new_historical_printables
proposals.first_test_product: A KDP journal with a cover featuring a historically accurate (public domain) Roman mosaic pattern and blank, aged-looking interior pages.
